_comment: One entry per publication. theme: gravity | magnetic | parallel | reconfigurable | medical | theory | collab. rep: true marks a representative paper shown first on its theme page. anim: path to an animation page once one exists.

papers.title: Complete gravity balancing of the general four-bar linkage using linear springs
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H.
papers.note: Sole author. The home-page animation is drawn from this paper.
papers.short: Balancing any four-bar linkage with two springs
papers.blurb: A weight on the coupler is equivalent to one on the crank and one on the rocker; two zero-free-length springs carry it exactly.

papers.title: Perfect static balancing using Cardan-gear spring mechanisms
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H. and Wu, Y.-X.
papers.short: Perfect balancing with a Cardan gear
papers.blurb: A gear turning inside one twice its size moves a point in a straight line, so an ordinary spring balances an arm exactly.

papers.title: Gravity compensation design of Delta parallel robots using gear-spring modules
papers.authors: Nguyen, V. L., Lin, C.-Y. and Kuo, C.-H.
papers.blurb: Gear pair, rod and spring packed along a robot arm; three of them take most of the weight off a Delta robot’s motors.

papers.title: A single-degree-of-freedom self-regulated gravity balancer for adjustable payload
papers.authors: Chu, Y.-L. and Kuo, C.-H.
papers.venue: ASME Journal of Mechanisms and Robotics
papers.short: A balancer that re-sets itself to the load
papers.blurb: Change the payload and the mechanism moves its own spring attachments until it is balanced again, unpowered.

papers.title: Performance analysis of gravity-balanced serial robotic manipulators under dynamic loads
papers.authors: Nguyen, V. L., Kuo, C.-H. and Lin, P. T.

papers.authors: Nguyen, V. L., Kuo, C.-H. and Lin, P. T.
papers.venue: ASME Journal of Mechanisms and Robotics

papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H., Nguyen, V. L., Robertson, D., Chou, L.-T. and Herder, J. L.
papers.venue: ASME Journal of Mechanisms and Robotics

papers.title: Gravity compensation design of planar articulated robotic arms using the gear-spring modules
papers.authors: Nguyen, V. L., Lin, C.-Y. and Kuo, C.-H.
papers.venue: ASME Journal of Mechanisms and Robotics

papers.note: Technology transferred to Syncmold Enterprise Co.; US Patent 2015/0053830 A1, Display Lifting Device.

papers.title: A modularization approach for gravity compensation of planar articulated robotic manipulators
papers.authors: Nguyen, V. L. and Kuo, C.-H.
papers.venue: In: Arakelian, V. (ed.), Gravity Compensation in Robotics, Springer

papers.title: Gravity balancing of mechanisms
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H.
papers.venue: In: JSME Handbook of Mechanisms in Motion, Corona Publishing, Tokyo (invited, in press)

papers.title: A reconfigurable Halbach cylinder for gravity compensation of variable rotational payloads
papers.authors: Biggs, E., Kuo, C.-H. and Ren, T.
papers.short: A Halbach cylinder that re-sets to the load
papers.blurb: Eight gear-mounted magnets balance a rotating payload; one lever turns them alternately and weakens the field to suit a lighter load.

papers.title: Passive levitation in long vertical range using two permanent magnets
papers.authors: Zeng, X., Li, S., Kuo, C.-H. and Sariyildiz, E.
papers.short: Floating a load on two magnets
papers.blurb: A 5 mm cube carrying 200 times its weight floats in a V-shaped trench cut into a larger magnet, through three times its own height.

papers.title: Design optimization and validation of a permanent-magnet array for gravity compensation in long-stroke linear motion
papers.authors: Zeng, X., Kuo, C.-H. and Sariyildiz, E.
papers.short: A magnet array for a long vertical stroke
papers.blurb: Four optimised columns of stator magnets lift a slider 20 times its magnet’s weight over 60 mm; the force curve is computed live.

papers.title: A computational approach for the analysis and synthesis of the interactive force between two general permanent magnets by using Monte Carlo integration
papers.authors: Zeng, X., Kuo, C.-H. and Sariyildiz, E.
papers.short: The force between any two magnets, by random sampling
papers.blurb: Monte Carlo integration of the magnet-force integral: random points rain into two magnets of odd shapes and the estimate converges.

papers.title: A triple-magnet passive gravity compensator: sensitivity-based design and experimental validation
papers.authors: Li, S., Zeng, X. and Kuo, C.-H.

papers.title: Structure synthesis of a class of parallel manipulators with fully decoupled projective motion
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H. and Dai, J. S.
papers.venue: ASME Journal of Mechanisms and Robotics
papers.short: One motor, one angle: projective motion
papers.blurb: Describe an axis by the angles of its two shadows and each motor of a parallel manipulator can set one of them alone.

papers.title: A non-overconstrained variant of the Agile Eye with a special decoupled kinematics
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H., Dai, J. S. and Legnani, G.
papers.short: A wrist whose three motors do not interfere
papers.blurb: Three planes hinged on the base axes each hold one point of a platform on a ball joint; one motor turns one plane.

papers.title: Task-oriented structure synthesis of a class of parallel manipulators using motion constraint generator
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H. and Dai, J. S.
papers.short: One leg decides the motion, the others drive it
papers.blurb: A serial constraint leg fixes what the platform can do; constraint-free legs carry the motors. Remove the leg and see why.

papers.title: A partially-decoupled 4-DOF general 3SPS/PS parallel manipulator
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H. and Dai, J. S.
papers.venue: In: Legnani, G. and Fassi, I. (eds), Robotics: State of the Art and Future Trends, Nova Science

papers.title: Configuration analysis of a class of reconfigurable cube mechanisms: mobility and configuration isomorphism
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H. and Su, J.-W.
papers.short: A cube of eight cubes that folds into other shapes
papers.blurb: Eight hinged sub-cubes fold from cube to slab to cube: an 8R loop whose mobility appears when two hinges line up.

papers.title: Structure decomposition and homomorphism identification of planar variable topology mechanisms
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H. and Chang, L.-Y.
papers.venue: ASME Journal of Mechanisms and Robotics
papers.blurb: The steel clamping and sawing mechanism closes a clamp, stiffens, then saws; its topology graph changes live.

papers.title: On the mobility and configuration singularity of mechanisms with variable topologies
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H. and Yan, H.-S.
papers.short: Counting freedoms when the topology keeps changing
papers.blurb: A push-button lock through four stages, with the mobility that screw theory gets right and the planar formula gets wrong.

papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H., Su, J.-W. and Wu, L.-C.

papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H., Dai, J. S. and Yan, H.-S.

papers.authors: Yan, H.-S. and Kuo, C.-H.

papers.title: Structural Characteristics of Mechanisms with Variable Topologies: Taking into Account the Configuration Singularity
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H.

papers.title: A novel reconfigurable gravity balancer for lower-limb rehabilitation with switchable hip/knee-only exercise
papers.authors: Tseng, T.-Y., Lin, Y.-J., Hsu, W.-C., Lin, L.-F. and Kuo, C.-H.
papers.venue: ASME Journal of Mechanisms and Robotics
papers.note: US Patent 9,592,415 B2, Auxiliary Device for Muscle Strength Training.
papers.short: A leg support that balances hip or knee
papers.blurb: Seven links, two springs, two modes: lock one joint, swing the other, and the leg’s weight is carried at every angle.

papers.title: Design of a novel statically balanced mechanism for laparoscope holders with decoupled positioning and orientating manipulation
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H. and Lai, S.-J.
papers.venue: ASME Journal of Mechanisms and Robotics
papers.short: A laparoscope holder that places, then aims
papers.blurb: A double parallelogram carries the pivot point to the incision; a parallel wrist aims the scope about it; springs balance both.

papers.title: Kinematics of a fully-decoupled remote center-of-motion parallel manipulator for minimally invasive surgery
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H. and Dai, J. S.
papers.short: Four motions about one point, one motor each
papers.blurb: Two tilts, spin and insertion of a surgical tool about the incision, each on its own actuator.

papers.authors: Yeow, B. S., Wang, A., Kuo, C.-H. and Ren, H.

papers.title: Linkage Synthesis and Force Analysis by Using Relative Poles
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H.
papers.short: Where a moving body turns about
papers.blurb: Set a second position of a body and watch the two bisectors find the relative pole; the body swings about it.

papers.title: Computational identification of link adjacency and joint incidence in kinematic chains and mechanisms
papers.authors: Kuo, C.-H. and Shih, J.-C.
papers.short: Which links are the same link?
papers.blurb: Watt and Stephenson chains with their equivalent links and joints highlighted class by class; fix a link and watch the classes split.
